the only thing sent to Devon was the automated thank-you email","justification":"Records show no goods or services transaction associated with Devon's payment, establishing it is not a payment for goods or services."},{"id":"a7","status":"TRUE","evidence_quote":"no discount or other benefit was offered","justification":"The scenario explicitly states no benefit of any kind was provided to Devon in connection with the donation."},{"id":"a8","status":"TRUE","evidence_quote":"distinct from the employer deduction file, the securities transfer journal","justification":"The payment is explicitly distinguished from the securities transfer journal, confirming it is not a donation of shares."},{"id":"a9","status":"TRUE","evidence_quote":"distinct from … the charity-card and voucher processor's separately numbered settlement batch","justification":"The payment is explicitly distinguished from the charity-card and voucher settlement batch, confirming it was not made via a charity card or voucher."}],"scope_issues":["The scenario mentions multiple donors paying monthly by direct debit; each of those donations is a separate decision unit and would require individual assessment — this evaluation covers only the single £95 donation from Devon Gray dated 1 March 2026.","The partial Gift Aid declaration form references an earlier gift and its coverage/duration pages are missing; whether any declaration validly extends to this March 2026 donation cannot be determined from the supplied policy passages alone."]}
